results: 1. adduction in horizontal gaze (each eye): limited adduction of the RIGHT eye that fails to cross the midline, with abducting nystagmus of the left eye on left gaze - mimics an INO
2. MRI sella and orbits: subtle MEDIAL ORBITAL WALL FRACTURE with medial rectus involvement; no brainstem pathology
3. CT head (non-contrast): multiple skull fractures and epidural haemorrhage; NO evidence of brainstem injury
4. forced duction test: restriction consistent with a mechanical cause
dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Pseudo-internuclear ophthalmoplegia (pseudo-INO) of the right eye due to entrapment of the right medial rectus in a medial orbital wall fracture.
Alternatives:
- Traumatic direct injury to the right medial rectus muscle (without entrapment)
- Orbital haematoma causing secondary mechanical restriction of the medial rectus
- True traumatic internuclear ophthalmoplegia from a missed brainstem injury (less likely given normal CT brainstem and positive forced duction test)
dx: Pseudo-internuclear ophthalmoplegia (pseudo-INO) of the right eye due to entrapment of the right medial rectus in a medial orbital wall fracture.
